_comment: Thin pointer. Copy this ENTIRE hooks block into C:/Users/EQ/.claude/settings.json (USER scope) -- root-scope-only wiring (C:/Projects/.claude/settings.json) silently doesn't fire for a session launched inside a repo or worktree, which is the common case. That gap hit SessionStart (fixed 2026-07-12) and then pre_tool_use.py's F9 check (fixed 2026-08-05, system/failures.md -> F9 recurrence 4) before this template was corrected to match. The LOGIC lives in the governed, versioned repo (eq-context/hooks/); nothing here but wiring -- see Phase 4: facts live in one place. Forward slashes only, everywhere in this file including comments -- backslash Windows paths get silently mangled by this harness's hook-command parsing (found + fixed 2026-07-27, sessions/2026-07-27.md) and can produce invalid JSON if hand-edited carelessly (found 2026-08-05). auto_pr_guard.py wired 2026-08-05 -- it's a true no-op for normal sessions (exits before reading stdin unless EQ_AUTO_PR_MODE=1 is set), so wiring it ahead of any scheduled/automated run actually existing costs nothing and means the leash is already in place the day one does. UserPromptSubmit/substrate_sync.py added 2026-08-15: this hook previously existed ONLY as an inline PowerShell blob in the live settings.json -- unversioned, untested, and absent from this template, so there was nothing for it to drift from. It swallowed its own pull failures with *>$null and the clone silently ran 34 commits behind while every gate reported green (system/failures.md -> F1).
